# cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudflare_zero_trust_cws_policy" "example_zero_trust_cws_policy" {
  account_id = "xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx"
  policy_id = "182bd5e5-6e1a-4fe4-a799-aa6d9a6ab26e"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account ID (32-character hexadecimal string)

### Optional

- `find_one_by` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--find_one_by))
- `policy_id` (String) ID of the policy to retrieve

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `description` (String) Optional free-form description.
- `entrypoint` (String) Non-function rule declared in rego_source. Evaluation uses data.<package_path>.<entrypoint>.
- `filter` (String) Filter expression that determines whether this policy applies. Maximum 4096 UTF-8 bytes.
- `id` (String) ID of the policy to retrieve
- `name` (String) Human-readable name; unique per account
- `package_path` (String) Dotted path derived from rego_source. Begins with policy. and is unique per account.
- `rego_source` (String) Inline Rego source with a package beginning with "policy." Maximum 16384 UTF-8 bytes.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags attached to this policy
- `updated_at` (String)

<a id="nestedatt--find_one_by"></a>
### Nested Schema for `find_one_by`

Optional:

- `direction` (String) Sort direction (default: asc)
Available values: "asc", "desc".
- `name` (String) Filter by policy name (case-insensitive substring match)
- `order` (String) Field to order results by (default: created_at)
Available values: "name", "created_at", "updated_at".
- `package_path` (String) Filter by package path (case-sensitive literal substring match)
- `policy_set_id` (String) Filter to policies attached to (members of) this policy set
